opening_question: Namaste. Sar dard ke baare mein bataiye — kab se ho raha hai?

mandatory_slots.question: Sar dard kab se hai — achanak shuru hua ya dheere-dheere?
Dard sar mein kahan hota hai — poora sar, ek side, ya aankhon ke aaspaas?
Dard kaisa hai — dabaav jaisa, dhak-dhak (throbbing), ya tez chubhan jaisa?
1 se 10 ke beech dard kitna tez hai?
Kis cheez se dard badhta hai — roshni, awaaz, ya movement se?

screening_questions.question: Sar dard ke saath ulti jaisa lagta hai?
Dikhne mein koi dikkat ya dhundhla dikhna hua hai?
Kya ye aapki zindagi ka sabse tez sar dard hai, jo achanak hua ho?
Gardan akadti hai ya bukhaar ke saath dard hai?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi migraine ya sar dard ki bimari rahi hai?
Ghar mein kisi ko migraine ya aisi problem hai?
